form:FormGroup.label: Field Use
form:FormGroup.helpText: How Stroom treats the field when searching and indexing, e.g. Text, Long or Date. This decides which query conditions can be used on the field.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Sets which query conditions the field supports.

form:FormGroup.label: Field Name
form:FormGroup.helpText: Name of the field in Solr. Must start with a letter or underscore and contain only letters, digits and underscores. Must be unique in this index.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Letters, digits and underscores; must not start with a digit.

form:FormGroup.label: Field Type
form:FormGroup.helpText: Solr field type to use for this field, as defined in the collection's schema. The list is read from Solr.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Types are read from the Solr schema.

form:FormGroup.label: Default Value
form:FormGroup.helpText: Value Solr stores for this field when a document does not supply one. Leave blank for no default.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Used when a document has no value.

form:FormGroup.helpText: Whether the field's value is stored in Solr, so it can be returned in search results without extracting it from the original data.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Stored values can be returned in results.

form:FormGroup.helpText: Whether the field can be searched. Only indexed fields can be used in query conditions.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Only indexed fields can be used in query conditions.

form:FormGroup.helpText: Whether Solr may build an in-memory copy of an indexed field without Doc Values when sorting or faceting on it. Doc Values are usually a better choice, as this copy uses a lot of memory.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Lets Solr sort without Doc Values, using a lot of memory.

form:FormGroup.helpText: Whether the field's values are also stored by column, which makes sorting, faceting and grouping on the field faster and use less memory.
Whether a document can have more than one value for the field.
Whether every document must have a value for the field. Solr rejects a document without one.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Solr rejects documents without a value.

form:FormGroup.helpText: Whether to leave out the field's length normalisation, which favours matches in shorter values when ranking results. Saves memory; usually ticked for fields that aren't full text.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Saves memory; shorter values are no longer ranked higher.

form:FormGroup.helpText: Whether to leave out the position of each term. Saves space, but the field can no longer match phrases.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Saves space, but phrases can't be matched.

form:FormGroup.helpText: Whether to leave out how often each term occurs and where. Saves space, but the field can no longer match phrases, and a term repeated in a value doesn't rank it higher.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Saves space, but phrases can't be matched.

form:FormGroup.helpText: Whether to store a list of the field's terms for each document, used by highlighting and 'more like this' searches.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Used by highlighting and similar-document searches.

form:FormGroup.helpText: Whether the stored term vectors include each term's position. Only used when Term Vectors is ticked.
Whether the stored term vectors include each term's start and end in the value, which speeds up highlighting. Only used when Term Vectors is ticked.
Whether the stored term vectors include each term's payload, extra data some analysers attach to terms. Only used when Term Vectors is ticked.
Whether documents with no value for the field come first when sorting on it, whichever way the sort goes.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Documents without a value sort first.

form:FormGroup.helpText: Whether documents with no value for the field come last when sorting on it, whichever way the sort goes.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Documents without a value sort last.
